742:t_000:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Tch! What is that black $$アンゲロイ$$!?」

742:t_000:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I've seen them deployed in the battle in the $$ルクバト星系$$.」

742:t_000:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「The way they crushed the enemy forces that kept resisting, with overwhelming power... It was truly an emissary of God.」

742:t_000:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Yes... It must be the military power of the $$サイデリアル$$'s rulers, who are shrouded in mystery.」

742:t_000:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「So they not only gave up on us, their subordinates, but sent that thing to purge us!」

742:t_000:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It seems the emissaries of God are appearing not just here but in all sorts of places.」

742:t_000:7.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「This overwhelming power...! At this rate, every front will collapse in no time!」

742:t_000:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... either way, if this ultra-wide-area warping of the dimensional boundary line continues, the universe itself won't hold out, though.」

742:t_000:10.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「What is it, Miss $$尸刻$$!?」

742:t_000:11.en:
$$尸刻$$
「...The force that seeks to vanish is trying to concentrate in a single direction...」

742:t_000:13.en:
$$尸刻$$
「The third planet of the Solar System...」

747:t_000:0.en:
$$ジノ$$
「An enemy attack the moment we deactivate $$スヴェル$$, huh!」

747:t_000:1.en:
$$アーニャ$$
「We'll be Earth's shield in its place.」

747:t_000:2.en:
$$ジェレミア$$
「$$アーニャ$$ is right! We must not forget that Earth lies behind us!」

747:t_000:3.en:
$$藤堂$$
「But the power of that black $$アンゲロイ$$...! It's nothing like the $$新地球皇国$$'s!」

747:t_000:4.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「So that's the force that answers directly to the $$御使い$$s that we've heard about!」

747:t_000:5.en:
$$カティ$$
「Regroup! Don't let a single enemy unit through!」

747:t_000:6.en:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Roger! All units, follow me!」

747:t_000:7.en:
$$ハリー$$
「The warping of space and the $$御使い$$s' assault...! Humanity's future must lie beyond them!」

747:t_000:8.en:
$$マリュー$$
「We can't lose, no matter what...!」

747:t_000:9.en:
$$ムウ$$
「I'll make that miracle happen, just watch!」

747:t_000:10.en:
$$ラクス$$
(I believe in you, $c... In your victory.)

747:t_000:11.en:
$$ラクス$$
(The feelings of all living beings... I entrust them to you.)

752:t_1:4.en:
???
「The gap between the void and existence... You could call this the nothingness before the beginning.」

752:t_1:7.en:
$n
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! How did you escape the dimensional barrier!」

752:t_1:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Surely the me of not long ago would have been caught in that cage and put on a pitiful display.」

752:t_1:9.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But within me, there were three eternities. They gave me strength.」

752:t_1:10.en:
$n
「Your own life... and the lives of $$アサキム$$ and $$サクリファイ$$...」

752:t_1:11.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Heh heh... You truly are a gallant one. Even with the proof of blood carved into you, you bravely try to come at me.」

752:t_1:12.en:
$n
「I'm not the man I was back when I cowered in fear of $$テンシ$$ anymore!」

752:t_1:13.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You all worked just as I intended... no, even harder than that.」

752:t_1:14.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And of all of you, I hold special feelings for the one who endured the trials I imposed.」

752:t_1:15.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Yes... those words of love just now came from my true heart.」

752:t_1:16.en:
$n
「Shut up! Neither I, nor $$アサキム$$, nor the people of Earth are your possessions!」

752:t_1:17.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「What do you say, $n? Would you like to welcome a new world with me?」

752:t_1:19.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The Volunteer Club, I believe it was called... That is a wonderful thing.」

752:t_1:20.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The $$ウィスパード$$ girl must have foreseen this day when she created that club.」

752:t_1:22.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「For the sake of what you must do, you don't hesitate to throw your life away.」

752:t_1:23.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Asking nothing in return, turning your back even on love...」

752:t_1:25.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「As the one who will carry this world's memories to the next world, $F... I choose you.」

752:t_1:26.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「If you wish it...」

752:t_1:28.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You reject salvation, then...」

752:t_1:29.en:
$n
「Don't screw with me! You're the one who took my family from me! You, I will never forgive!!」

752:t_1:30.en:
$n
「If you're going to play god anyway, then save every last human being! And if you can't, then give it everything you have as one human being!」

752:t_1:31.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You dare lecture me, who have surpassed even the $$御使い$$s... That is why I find you all so endearing.」

752:t_1:32.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But you chose wrongly. You went from one who would witness the beginning of a new world to one who will see the old world off at its end.」

752:t_1:34.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「This is goodbye, $n. The end of myth... That will be the place where you meet your end.」

752:t_1:36.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Yes... It will become the star of a new beginning.」

752:t_1:43.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What is it!? What are you trying to say!?」
